privacy_level_options.note: An API value must match one of the creator's privacy_level_options from creator_info.

privacy_no_default.quote: Users must manually select the privacy status from a dropdown and there should be no default value.

interaction_defaults_off.quote: Users must manually turn on these interaction settings and none should be checked by default.

unaudited_client_visibility.quote: All content posted by unaudited clients will be restricted to private viewing mode.
unaudited_client_visibility.note: An audit is required to lift the restriction. Applies to Content Posting API clients, not to the TikTok app itself.

api_permissions.note: Direct Post requires approval for the video.publish scope and the user's authorization. Draft-upload scope names were not on the fetched page.

caption_editable_no_watermark.note: Preset caption text and hashtags must stay editable; API clients must not add promotional watermarks or logos.

caption_links_clickable.note: No official statement found. Do not rely on a caption URL being tappable.
